description: The server's levels window with hysteresis (CLIENT-UI-PLAN.md §2.3). Feed each row's dB bins with its capture time; after each, expect the window. Wanted floor = 20th percentile - 10; wanted top = max(floor + 60, 99.7th percentile + 6); percentiles are linear between closest ranks (numpy default, R type 7). The first row sets the window. After that it moves to the wanted window only once either edge has been more than 3 dB from the current one on every row for at least 2000 ms (measured from the first such row); a row within 3 dB at both edges restarts the wait. dbStep8 = (top - floor)/256. noiseDb is the 20th percentile and peakDb the maximum, of every row. Compare within 1e-9.

cases.note: noise jitter only: set once on the first row, never again
noise up 15 dB for 1.5 s then back: under 2 s, no move
noise up 15 dB from row 2 (t=500 ms): moves at the first row 2 s later, row 10
noise up 2 dB for good: within the 3 dB hysteresis, no move
a carrier 70 dB up holds the top high; when it goes for 2 s the top comes down (either edge, either direction)
out for 1.75 s, in for one row, out again: the 2 s restarts
